Armstrong: Armstrong became famous all over the world after walking on the moon.
阿姆斯特朗在登上月球后变得闻名于全世界。
subscribe to: We subscribe to several English magazines to improve our reading skills.
我们订阅了几本英语杂志来提高阅读能力。
byproduct: Electricity is a useful byproduct of the process that treats waste water.
电是处理废水过程中一种有用的副产品。
Janice: Janice has lived in this small town since she was born.
贾尼丝从出生起就一直住在这个小镇上。
Foster: Mr. Foster asked us to hand in our homework before Friday.
福斯特先生要求我们在星期五之前交作业。
Celsius: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
在海平面上,水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
quantities of: Large quantities of rubbish are produced in big cities every day.
大城市每天产生大量的垃圾。
go up: The price of oil went up again last month.
上个月石油价格又上涨了。
Charles Keeling: Charles Keeling spent years measuring carbon dioxide levels in the atmosphere.
查尔斯·基林花了多年时间测量大气中的二氧化碳含量。
result in: His careless driving resulted in a serious accident last night.
他粗心的驾驶昨晚导致了一场严重的事故。
George Hambley: George Hambley believes that global warming will not cause serious problems.
乔治·汗布利认为全球变暖不会造成严重的问题。
opposed: The two scientists held opposed views on the cause of climate change.
这两位科学家对气候变化的原因持截然相反的观点。
be opposed to: Many local people are opposed to building a factory near their homes.
许多当地人反对在他们的住所附近建工厂。
environmentalist: The environmentalist gave a speech about protecting endangered animals at our school.
这位环境保护论者在我们学校做了一场关于保护濒危动物的演讲。
even if: Even if it rains tomorrow, we will still go hiking as planned.
即使明天下雨,我们仍将按计划去远足。
keep on: Keep on trying, and you will succeed in the end.
继续努力,你最终会成功的。
on the whole: On the whole, the students performed well in the final exam.
大体上,学生们在期末考试中表现良好。
hectare: The farm covers about twenty hectares of land near the river.
这家农场在河边占地约二十公顷。
on behalf of: He made a speech on behalf of all the graduates at the ceremony.
他在典礼上代表全体毕业生发了言。
put up with: I can't put up with the noise from the street any longer.
我再也忍受不了街上传来的噪音了。
so long as: So long as you keep practicing, your spoken English will improve.
只要你坚持练习,你的英语口语就会提高。
and so on: The shop sells bread, milk, eggs, fruit and so on.
这家店出售面包、牛奶、鸡蛋、水果等等。
volcanic: The village was covered with volcanic ash after the eruption.
火山喷发后,这个村庄覆盖着一层火山灰。
volcanology: She studies volcanology because she wants to understand how volcanoes work.
她学习火山学,因为她想弄清楚火山是如何活动的。
volcanologist: The volcanologist climbed close to the crater to collect fresh lava samples.
这位火山学家爬到火山口附近去采集新鲜的熔岩样本。
Mount Kilauea: Mount Kilauea in Hawaii is one of the most active volcanoes in the world.
夏威夷的基拉韦厄火山是世界上最活跃的火山之一。
burn to the ground: The old wooden house burned to the ground within an hour.
那座旧木屋在一小时内全部焚毁。
molten: Molten rock flowed slowly down the side of the mountain.
熔化的岩石顺着山坡缓缓流下。
spaceman: The young boy dreams of becoming a spaceman and flying to Mars.
这个小男孩梦想成为一名宇航员并飞往火星。
make one’s way: After the meeting, she made her way to the train station.
Mount Etna: Mount Etna, located in Italy, erupts several times every year.
位于意大利的埃特纳火山每年喷发好几次。
Sicily: Sicily is a beautiful island in the south of Italy.
西西里岛是意大利南部一座美丽的岛屿。
Mount Vesuvius: Mount Vesuvius erupted suddenly and buried the ancient city long ago.
很久以前,维苏威火山突然喷发,掩埋了那座古城。
Pompeii: Pompeii was buried under ash and stones after the terrible eruption.
那次可怕的火山喷发之后,庞培城被埋在了灰烬和石块之下。
tsunami: The tsunami destroyed many houses along the coast in a few minutes.
海啸在几分钟内摧毁了沿海的许多房屋。
glance through: I glanced through the report quickly before the meeting began.
会议开始前,我匆匆看了一遍报告。
Manchu: The Manchu people have many interesting traditions and colorful festivals.
满族有许多有趣的传统和丰富多彩的节日。
vary from…to…: The prices of hotel rooms here vary from one hundred to five hundred dollars.
这里宾馆房间的价格从一百美元到五百美元不等。
suffering: The war brought great suffering to the people in that country.
战争给那个国家的人民带来了巨大的苦难。
gall-bladder: Eating too much fatty food may cause gall-bladder problems.
吃太多油腻的食物可能会引发胆囊问题。
